answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and confined to the primary region while settlement writes must be kept. memory_b2 is the closest prior: regional failover restored latency and shifted traffic cleanly without implying dropped writes. Rollback remains plausible given the 2h-old release (memory_b1) but a region-local symptom is a weaker fit for a fleet-wide bad build. Circuit breaking is rejected because failing fast would shed customer writes (memory_b4), against the objective. Read-replica routing and last-minute capacity do not target a region-scoped write path. Verifying memory_b2 before commit; cause is still uncertain so this is a write-preserving availability move, not a root-cause claim.
